name: linklens
description: Link shortener with JWT authentication and click analytics, built with Next.js, Express and TypeScript

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
